# push の状態の遷移表 (#330)。生成: crates/notecore/tests/push_state_golden.rs
# マス = 遷移後の状態 g世代 / 届いた push の扱い / 後始末のキュー (変わったときだけ。
# U = 本家の解除、T = 印の取り消し、R = 配送アプリから外す)

## off (off)
push                → off / drop
push(other gen)     → off / drop
disable             → off
app switched        → off
new gen             → pending g1
gen failed          → off
endpoint gone       → off
server key changed  → off
missed x2           → off
reconcile           → off / queue[g0:UR]
reconcile +11 min   → off / queue[g0:UR]
cleanup done        → off

## preparing (preparing g1)
push                → active g1 / confirmed
push(other gen)     → preparing g1 / drop
disable             → unregistering g1 / queue[g1:UR]
app switched        → preparing g1
new gen             → pending g2 / queue[g1:UR]
gen failed          → off g1 / queue[g1:R]
endpoint gone       → preparing g1
server key changed  → preparing g1
missed x2           → preparing g1
reconcile           → preparing g1
reconcile +11 min   → off g1 / queue[g1:R]
cleanup done        → preparing g1

## pending (pending g1)
push                → active g1 / confirmed
push(other gen)     → pending g1 / drop
disable             → unregistering g1 / queue[g1:UTR]
app switched        → needsRereg:endpoint g1
new gen             → pending g2 / queue[g1:UR]
gen failed          → pending g1
endpoint gone       → needsRereg:endpoint g1
server key changed  → pending g1
missed x2           → pending g1
reconcile           → pending g1
reconcile +11 min   → pending g1
cleanup done        → pending g1

## active (active g1)
push                → active g1 / show
push(other gen)     → active g1 / drop
disable             → unregistering g1 / queue[g1:UTR]
app switched        → needsRereg:endpoint g1
new gen             → pending g2 / queue[g1:UR]
gen failed          → active g1
endpoint gone       → needsRereg:endpoint g1
server key changed  → needsRereg:server g1
missed x2           → needsRereg:missing g1
reconcile           → active g1
reconcile +11 min   → active g1
cleanup done        → active g1

## needsRereg:endpoint (needsRereg:endpoint g1)
push                → needsRereg:endpoint g1 / show
push(other gen)     → needsRereg:endpoint g1 / drop
disable             → unregistering g1 / queue[g1:UTR]
app switched        → needsRereg:endpoint g1
new gen             → pending g2 / queue[g1:UR]
gen failed          → needsRereg:endpoint g1
endpoint gone       → needsRereg:endpoint g1
server key changed  → needsRereg:endpoint g1
missed x2           → needsRereg:endpoint g1
reconcile           → needsRereg:endpoint g1
reconcile +11 min   → needsRereg:endpoint g1
cleanup done        → needsRereg:endpoint g1

## needsRereg:migrated (needsRereg:migrated g0)
push                → needsRereg:migrated g0 / show

push                → unregistering g1 / drop

disable             → unregistering g1
app switched        → unregistering g1
